title: A tool proves a test-suite speed-up lost no test
goal: _tools/perfcheck.py compares the test ids tests.py and stress_test.py collect at HEAD with those at a base revision (a missing id fails it unless an --allow-removed file names it, added ones are listed) and times a suite run against a stated bound, and its own tests plant a dropped test id and an over-bound run that make it fail.

gates.question: How is the baseline _tools/test_ids_baseline.txt refreshed when tests are added?
options: append: whoever adds tests regenerates it with perfcheck.py ids --write, ids only grow; a removal needs an --allow-removed file
pin: the file is fixed at the epic's start and never rewritten
gates.recommendation: append: whoever adds tests regenerates it with perfcheck.py ids --write, ids only grow; a removal needs an --allow-removed file
gates.answer: append: whoever adds tests regenerates it with perfcheck.py ids --write, ids only grow; a removal needs an --allow-removed file

gates.question: What counts as the tests.py and stress_test.py selections whose ids perfcheck collects?
options: two selections: tests.py (_tools, -m "not stress") and stress_test.py (test_stress.py, -m stress), fixed as constants checked by a test against both runners
every id pytest collects with no -m filter
gates.recommendation: two selections: tests.py (_tools, -m "not stress") and stress_test.py (test_stress.py, -m stress), fixed as constants checked by a test against both runners
gates.answer: two selections: tests.py (_tools, -m "not stress") and stress_test.py (test_stress.py, -m stress), fixed as constants checked by a test against both runners

notes: _tools/test_ids_baseline.txt is the id list of tests.py and stress_test.py at the commit before the epic's first change (1,223 ids: 1,134 by tests.py plus the 89 stress ids); a later story that adds tests appends their ids, and one that removes a test id needs the operator's word. A planted-failure test is one that plants a defect and asserts a check reports it; the id comparison proves each is still collected, tests.py proves each still passes. perfcheck.py and test_ids_baseline.txt do not exist yet, and every other story of EP-hlnsqx4f waits on them.
